subject.title: Node host: no SSH transport support + challenge auth fails behind reverse proxy

question: Should OpenClaw add managed SSH transport to node-host run/install, keep manual tunnels as the supported path, or split this issue so #91126 owns pairing/auth while this item remains transport-only?
rationale: The source proves the transport request is still missing, but adding it affects SSH process lifecycle, host trust, gateway auth, and service setup rather than a narrow code repair.

options.title: Split and define the remote node-host contract
options.body: Keep this issue open for managed SSH transport direction and let #91126 own the overlapping node registration and approval bugs.

options.title: Keep manual tunnels as supported
options.body: Close or narrow the SSH portion after documenting that node-host-managed SSH is intentionally out of scope, while leaving #91126 for auth/pairing fixes.

options.title: Approve managed SSH implementation
options.body: Proceed with a design that reuses the existing SSH helper, defines host-key and persistence behavior, and includes live remote-node proof.

recommendation.title: Split and define the remote node-host contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for managed SSH transport direction and let #91126 own the overlapping node registration and approval bugs.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central history signal across node-host runtime, gateway client, and node pairing paths.
